mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in the federal funds rate below 0.3% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate further easing.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not fall below 0.3% within the next trading day, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices in the same month signals robust economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase in the same month
failure_condition: Neither GDPC1 nor INDPRO increases in the same month, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decline in the federal funds rate accelerates economic growth, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.7% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate weakening labor demand and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not exceed 6.7% within the next trading day, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in demand (HOUST) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) in the same month signals robust economic activity and accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases and FEDFUNDS decreases in the same month
failure_condition: Neither HOUST nor FEDFUNDS move in the predicted direction simultaneously, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4%), a decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, amplifying equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with UNRATE < 4%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the supply index (INDPRO) over three consecutive months signals robust economic growth and expanding corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not increase for three consecutive months, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
